module: Filter that prevents the camera passing through scenery: casts static rays (castRayStatic) from the target to the four corners of the camera's near plane and moves the camera closer to the target if a wall is in the way (minimum distance 0.5 m). With no obstacle, only one corner is tested per frame (in turn); on first contact, all four are tested every frame until a clear frame. Active only if the 'cameraCollision' setting is true. Returns a constructor.
notes: Per-instance state (each view/split-screen has its own filter). Safety margin 0.1 m; near plane assumed 0.4 x 0.2 m. Smoothing only acts when the camera moves away (gradual return); moving closer is immediate.
The extracted page says isObstacleInFrontOfCam(cornerIdx) but the code takes (rayDestinations, cornerIdx).

init.desc: Resets the state (distances, ray index, smoothing) and reads the cameraCollision setting.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: re-reads the 'cameraCollision' setting (true by default).

isObstacleInFrontOfCam.desc: Detects geometry that the corner rays do not see: full crossing of a wall in one frame, or a near-plane edge that cuts a surface.

rayDestinations.desc: the 4 corners of the near plane

update.desc: Computes the new camera position on the target -> camera axis and writes data.res.pos.

collidingCamDistance.desc: Target -> camera distance imposed by collision.

returns.desc: distance in meters, nil if there is no collision
